permissions.name: dsh-all-rewind.git.snapshot
permissions.reason: Run `git add`/`write-tree` through the shadow repository to snapshot the workspace before every conversation turn.

permissions.name: dsh-all-rewind.git.restore
permissions.reason: Run `git read-tree` to restore workspace files when the user explicitly rewinds to an earlier turn.

permissions.name: dsh-all-rewind.git.store
permissions.reason: Keep one shadow git repository per workspace under the plugin data directory (configurable with dataDir).
